_about: Hoenn chapters, in the order the natural playthrough took them (natural-run-v101 rows 162–177, natural-run-v102 rows 178–207). Hoenn is a postgame-strength region: wild Pokémon are Level 70–78 and Trainers 80–100.

chapters.title: The Road to Hoenn
chapters.goal: Meet Professor Birch in Pallet Town and ride his truck to Littleroot.
need: Ash’s story in Viridian Forest finished (which needs Red beaten, plus the Boulder and Cascade Badges).
Bring healing items: Hoenn’s first shops sell only Potions.
quick: Fly to Pallet Town
Professor Oak and Professor Birch meet you as you land.
Find the truck
It is parked on the west side of town.
Talk at the rear door
Stand directly below the door at the truck’s east end, face up and press A. The truck’s body gives no prompt.
Say yes
You ride in the back and step out in Littleroot Town.
Choose a welcome gift
Brendan and May offer one of three Pokémon.

p: After Ash’s call, landing in Pallet Town starts a scene at once: Professor Oak introduces Professor Birch, who invites you to Hoenn and adds himself to your Pokégear. Oak’s lab has nothing more for this; Birch waits by his truck.

The moving truck stands on the west side of Pallet Town. Its body is silent when you press A on it. The prompt is at the rear door, the east end of the truck: stand on the tile directly below the door and face up.

Birch asks whether you would like to come to Littleroot Town. No leaves you where you are and he waits; Yes puts you in the back among the boxes. Your following Pokémon stays out of sight for the ride and returns when you arrive.

Brendan and May greet you outside the truck and offer one of three Pokémon they look after for the Professor as a welcome gift. If your party is full it goes straight to the PC. Both are added to your Pokégear.
The truck stays parked in Littleroot. It is your way back to Kanto whenever you like: the same rear door offers a ride to Pallet Town.

stuck: How do I get to Hoenn?
Beat Red on Mt. Silver, finish Ash’s story in Viridian Forest (you need the Boulder and Cascade Badges), then Fly to Pallet Town. Talk at the rear door of the truck on the west side of town.
Oak and Birch are not in Pallet Town

They appear only after Professor Oak’s phone call, which comes when Ash has given you his Pikachu and left Viridian Forest. If you beat Ash but did not take Pikachu, go back and talk to him: see [[kanto/ash|A Promise to Butterfree]].
The truck does nothing when I press A
The body of the truck is silent. Stand below the rear door at its east end, face up, and press A.
Can I go back to Kanto?
Yes. The truck in Littleroot Town takes you to Pallet Town from the same rear door, and back again.

chapters.title: Littleroot Town
chapters.goal: Walk to Petalburg City and help Wally catch his first Pokémon.
need: A team that has finished Kanto. Route 102’s Trainers are already Level 80.
quick: North on Route 101 to Oldale Town
Heal at the Pokémon Center.
West on Route 102
Trainers around Level 80.
Enter Petalburg Gym
Norman lends Wally a Zigzagoon; you watch him catch a Ralts.
Follow Norman’s advice
He points you to Rustboro. Scott introduces himself outside.

p: Hoenn opens as a postgame region. There is no starter battle on Route 101 and no rival on Route 103; the first rival battle is on Route 110. Birch’s lab holds one aide; the Professor himself is out in the field.
Oldale’s Mart, like Petalburg’s and Rustboro’s, sells only Poké Balls, Potions and three status heals, so rely on what you brought from Kanto.

In Petalburg Gym, Norman greets you and lends Wally a Zigzagoon and a Poké Ball. You follow him to Route 102 and watch him catch a Ralts. In the playthrough Norman was fought later, with four Hoenn Badges.

stuck: Is there a starter battle or a rival on Route 103?
No. You arrive as a veteran with a gift Pokémon; the first rival battle is on Route 110.
The shops only sell Potions
Hoenn’s Marts stock by Hoenn Badge count. Buy healing items in Kanto before you leave, or wait for Slateport and Mauville.
next: West on Route 104 and through Petalburg Woods.

chapters.title: Rustboro City
chapters.goal: Beat Roxanne, then chase down the Devon Goods.
need: Nothing new.
quick: Route 104 and Petalburg Woods
In the woods a Devon researcher is cornered by a Team Aqua grunt. Beat the grunt for a Great Ball.
Beat Roxanne
Rustboro Gym. Reward: Stone Badge and TM39 Rock Tomb.
Chase the thief
Leaving the Gym triggers the theft. Follow him to Route 116 and into Rusturf Tunnel.
Talk to the grunt
Step toward him, then talk to him to battle. You get the Devon Goods back.
Meet Mr. Stone
The researcher takes you to Devon’s top floor: a Letter for Steven and a Master Ball.

p: Two trainers stand before Roxanne. Her lead is Aerodactyl at Level 87, which Mega Evolves; Cradily, Armaldo and Probopass follow. Every Hoenn Leader has a Mega Evolution.

As you leave the Gym a grunt runs past with a researcher in pursuit. Go north-east to Route 116 and into Rusturf Tunnel. Walking up to the grunt makes him step back; he does not fight until you talk to him. Afterwards Mr. Briney collects his Wingull, Peeko.

Back in Rustboro the researcher leads you to Mr. Stone on Devon’s third floor. He gives you a Letter to deliver to Steven in Dewford and, in Project Blonde, a Master Ball. There is no PokéNav: your Pokégear does that job.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Roxanne
know: Mega Aerodactyl is fast and hits hard with Rock Slide. Rock, Steel, Water and Ice moves all work; Electric too.
Cradily shrugs off Water with Giga Drain and Recover. Use Fighting, Ice or Bug.

items: From the Devon researcher in Petalburg Woods.
Recovered from the grunt in Rusturf Tunnel.
From Mr. Stone, for Steven in Dewford.
From Mr. Stone on Devon Corp 3F.
stuck: The grunt in Rusturf Tunnel just stands there
He steps back when you approach. Walk up to him again and press A to talk; that starts the battle.
next: Mr. Briney’s cottage on the south part of Route 104, back through Petalburg Woods.

chapters.title: Dewford Town
chapters.goal: Sail to Dewford, beat Brawly and deliver the Letter to Steven.
need: The Devon Goods recovered (Mr. Briney sails once Peeko is safe).
quick: Talk to Mr. Briney in his cottage
Route 104, south of Petalburg Woods. He sails you to Dewford.
Beat Brawly
Reward: Knuckle Badge and TM08 Bulk Up.
Granite Cave
North-west of town along Route 106. 1F → B1F → B2F → B1F → 1F → Steven’s room.
Give Steven the Letter
He gives TM47 Steel Wing.
Sail to Slateport
Briney at the Dewford dock. The menu opens on EXIT: move up to SLATEPORT.

p: On the boat Norman phones and is added to your Pokégear. Brawly leads with Machop at Level 88. The Gym is dark and brightens as you beat its trainers.
Granite Cave does not need Flash. The route to Steven goes down two floors and back up to a separate room on 1F. Steven recognises you, takes the Letter and registers himself in your Pokégear.
At the dock, Mr. Briney’s menu offers Petalburg, Slateport and Exit, with the cursor starting on Exit.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Brawly
know: Flying, Psychic and Fairy moves are super effective. His Medicham Mega Evolves.

items: From Steven in Granite Cave when you deliver the Letter.
stuck: Briney’s menu closes without going anywhere
The cursor starts on EXIT. Move it up to SLATEPORT before pressing A.
Do I need Flash for Granite Cave?
No.
next: By boat with Mr. Briney; you land on Route 109’s beach.

chapters.title: Slateport City
chapters.goal: Deliver the Devon Goods to Captain Stern and battle your rival on the way to Mauville.
need: The Devon Goods.
quick: Walk up the beach into Slateport
Heal; the Mart here sells Great Balls and Super Potions.
Talk to Dock in Stern’s Shipyard
Until you do, a queue of grunts blocks the Museum door.
Enter the Oceanic Museum
¥50. A grunt you met before hands you TM46 Thief.
Upstairs: two grunts, then Archie
Hand the goods to Captain Stern.
North on Route 110
Professor Birch, then your rival. You receive the Dowsing Machine.

p: Team Aqua grunts stand in a line outside the Museum. They leave only after you speak to Dock on the ground floor of Stern’s Shipyard, who tells you the Captain is at the Museum.
Upstairs, two grunts attack in turn before Archie introduces himself and withdraws. Captain Stern takes the Devon Goods. Scott adds himself to your Pokégear as you leave.

Professor Birch is on Route 110 looking for his child. A little further on your rival (May if you play as a boy, Brendan if a girl) battles you with three Pokémon at Level 87. The team depends on the welcome gift you chose. The prize is the Dowsing Machine.

bosses.title: Rival: May or Brendan
know: Brendan uses the same teams if you play as a girl.

items: From the grunt inside the Oceanic Museum.
From your rival after the Route 110 battle.
stuck: Grunts block the Museum
Talk to Dock inside Stern’s Shipyard first.

chapters.title: Mauville City
chapters.sub: Wattson, Rock Smash & the Mach Bike
chapters.goal: Battle Wally, collect Rock Smash and the Mach Bike, and beat Wattson.
need: Nothing new.
quick: Battle Wally outside the Gym
He and his uncle are at the door. One Ralts, Level 87.
Visit Rydel’s bike shop
He gives you the Mach Bike.
Collect HM06 Rock Smash
From the man in the house to the right of the Mart row.
Beat Wattson
Reward: Dynamo Badge and TM34 Shock Wave.

p: Wally asks for a battle in front of the Gym. Afterwards he goes home to Verdanturf. Rydel hands over the Mach Bike, and the Rock Smash Guy gives HM06.
From v102 on, this HM06 breaks every rock in Hoenn. In v100 and v101 Hoenn’s rocks only broke if you had also been given Rock Smash on Johto’s Route 36; that was a bug and is fixed.
Wattson leads with Voltorb at Level 90 and his Manectric Mega Evolves. Ground moves end the fight quickly.

On Route 111, just north of the city, the Winstrate family challenge you to four battles in a row with no healing between; the reward inside the house is a Macho Brace. Route 117 to the west has breeders and the Day Care, and leads to Verdanturf Town with its Battle Tent.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Wattson
know: Ground types are immune to his Electric moves. Mega Manectric has Intimidate on Mega Evolving.

items: From Rydel in Mauville’s bike shop.
From the Rock Smash Guy in Mauville. Works on every Hoenn rock in v102.
From the Winstrate family on Route 111 after beating all four.
stuck: Rocks on Route 111 won’t break
On v100 or v101 this was a bug: update to v102 or later. From v102 on you only need HM06 from Mauville in your Bag.
next: North on Route 111, through the rocks, then west on Route 112.

chapters.title: Fallarbor Town
chapters.goal: Break through to the north and follow Team Magma to Meteor Falls.
need: Rock Smash for the two rocks on Route 111.
quick: Smash the rocks on Route 111
Two rocks block the way to Route 112.
Route 112 and Fiery Path
Magma grunts hold the Cable Car, so go through the cave.
Route 113 to Fallarbor
Volcanic ash falls on the route.
Route 114 to Meteor Falls
Team Magma takes the Meteorite; Archie and Team Aqua arrive too late.

p: The desert on Route 111 turns you back without the Go-Goggles, and the Cable Car station on Route 112 is occupied. The way round is Fiery Path, whose Strength boulders are optional, then Route 111’s northern stub and ash-covered Route 113.
From Fallarbor take Route 114 south to Meteor Falls. A few steps inside, Team Magma is leaving with a Meteorite bound for Mt. Chimney. Archie recognises you from the Museum and gives chase.

stuck: The Cable Car is blocked
Two Magma grunts hold it until you have seen the scene in Meteor Falls. Go round through Fiery Path.
The desert sends me back
You need the Go-Goggles, given outside Lavaridge Gym.
next: Back to Route 112: the Cable Car now runs.

chapters.title: Lavaridge Town
chapters.goal: Stop Maxie on Mt. Chimney, descend the Jagged Pass and beat Flannery.
need: The Meteor Falls scene.
quick: Ride the Cable Car
Route 112. It is free.
Mt. Chimney
Beat Tabitha, then Maxie.
Walk down the Jagged Pass
It ends at Lavaridge Town.
Lavaridge Gym
A maze of trapdoors over two floors. See the route below.
Beat Flannery
Reward: Heat Badge and TM50 Overheat.
Receive the Go-Goggles
Your rival is waiting outside the Gym.

p: Magma grunts and Tabitha (Numel lead) guard the path to Maxie, who is at the crater with the Meteorite. His Camerupt Mega Evolves. When he withdraws, Archie thanks you.

The Gym is two floors joined by holes and geysers. The sequence used in the playthrough, as floor and tile (x, y) of each hole or geyser you take: 1F (8,9) → B1F (0,17) → 1F (0,10) → B1F (0,6) → 1F (2,3) → B1F (7,2) → 1F (10,6) → B1F (12,12) → Flannery. The Gym’s area maps show the same coordinates.
Flannery opens with Numel at Level 92 and has Torkoal, Slugma and a Camerupt that Mega Evolves.
Outside, your rival gives you the Go-Goggles for the Route 111 desert. The old woman in town offers an Egg, but only if your party has room.

bosses.title: Magma Leader Maxie
know: Mega Camerupt is slow and four times weak to Water.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Flannery
know: Water and Ground moves are super effective on the whole team; Mega Camerupt is four times weak to Water.

items: From your rival outside Lavaridge Gym after the Heat Badge.
stuck: The Egg lady won’t give me the Egg
She has no PC option. Free a slot in your party and talk to her again.
next: Fly to Petalburg City. Fly works in Hoenn as soon as you have visited a town.
chapters.ev: v102 trace 182–183; puzzle route from website notes

chapters.title: Petalburg Gym
chapters.goal: Choose your rooms and beat Norman.
need: Four Hoenn Badges (as played).
quick: Read the door signs
The doors are signs: press A and answer Yes to go through.
Pick a route of three rooms
For example Speed, Confusion, Strength, then the Leader’s room.
Beat Norman
Reward: Balance Badge and TM42 Facade.
Follow Wally’s father
He takes you to his house and gives you a Rare Candy.

p: Each room holds one trainer around Level 90 and offers two doors onward. Any path of three rooms reaches Norman. He leads with Kangaskhan at Level 93, which Mega Evolves.
In the original game Wally’s father gives you Surf here. You already own Surf from Johto, so he gives a Rare Candy instead. The same swap happens wherever Hoenn would hand you an HM you already have.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Norman
know: Fighting moves throughout. Mega Kangaskhan attacks twice a turn: do not rely on Focus Sash or Sturdy.

items: From Wally’s father after the Balance Badge (in place of Surf).
stuck: The doors in Petalburg Gym don’t open
They are signs. Face one, press A and choose Yes.
When can I battle Norman?
The playthrough challenged him with four Hoenn Badges, after Flannery.
next: Fly to Mauville and go east on Route 118.

chapters.title: Fortree City
chapters.goal: Free the Weather Institute, earn the Devon Scope and beat Winona.
need: Surf, for the channel on Route 118.
quick: Surf across Route 118
A fisherman gives the Good Rod; Steven greets you on the far bank.
Route 119: the Weather Institute
Team Aqua holds it. Beat Shelly on 2F and receive Castform.
Battle your rival on the bridge
North end of Route 119. Rewards: Linking Cord and a Rare Candy.
Reach Fortree
The Gym door is blocked by something invisible.
Route 120: meet Steven on the bridge
He reveals a Kecleon and gives you the Devon Scope.
Use the Devon Scope at the Gym door
Then solve the rotating gates and beat Winona. Reward: Feather Badge and TM40 Aerial Ace.

p: Grunts at Level 91–93 fill both floors. The bed on the ground floor heals your party. Shelly waits upstairs with a Carvanha lead. The staff thank you with a Castform; with a full party it goes to the PC.
On the bridge at the north end of the route your rival battles you again. In the original game the prize is Fly. You already have it, so you receive a Linking Cord and a Rare Candy.

An invisible Pokémon blocks the short path on Route 120 and another blocks the Gym door. On Route 120’s long bridge Steven shows you the Devon Scope, a Kecleon attacks, and he gives you the scope. Use it at the Gym door.

Inside are rotating gates that turn when you push through them; they behave exactly as in the original game. One pair of trainers fights as a Double Battle. Winona leads with Swablu at Level 94 and her Altaria Mega Evolves.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Winona
know: Electric, Ice and Rock. Mega Altaria becomes Dragon / Fairy: Ice still works, Dragon moves do not.

items: A gift at the Weather Institute after beating Shelly.
From your rival on Route 119 (in place of Fly). It evolves trade-evolution Pokémon when used.
stuck: Something invisible blocks Fortree Gym
Go east to Route 120 and meet Steven on the bridge for the Devon Scope, then use it at the door.

chapters.title: Lilycove City
chapters.goal: Reach Lilycove, then climb Mt. Pyre and receive the Magma Emblem.
need: Surf, for Route 122.
quick: Route 121
Team Aqua runs past, heading for Mt. Pyre.
Lilycove City
Heal and shop at the Department Store.
Surf south on Route 122 to Mt. Pyre
Enter, go out onto the mountainside and climb to the summit.
Beat the Aqua grunts
Archie already has the Red Orb.
Talk to the old couple
They give you the Magma Emblem.

p: From inside the tower’s ground floor a door leads out to the exterior path. Four Aqua grunts stand between you and the summit. Archie announces that Maxie took one orb first and that he now holds the Red Orb.
The old couple who guarded the orbs give you the Magma Emblem, which opens Team Magma’s hideout on the Jagged Pass.
Lilycove’s Department Store sells the widest range of items in Hoenn, including TMs on its fourth floor.

items: From the old couple at Mt. Pyre’s summit.
stuck: Where do I use the Magma Emblem?
On the Jagged Pass, coming down from Mt. Chimney. A boulder shakes as you pass and the hideout opens.
next: Fly to Lavaridge and take the Cable Car.

chapters.title: The Hideouts
chapters.sub: Team Magma, the submarine & Team Aqua
chapters.goal: Chase Maxie through the Magma Hideout, see the submarine stolen and clear the Aqua Hideout.
need: The Magma Emblem.
Strength (HM04 from Johto) for the Magma Hideout’s first floor.
Surf, to reach the Aqua Hideout.
quick: Cable Car, then down the Jagged Pass
A boulder reacts to the Magma Emblem and the entrance opens.
Magma Hideout
Push the boulders on 1F with Strength; fight down to Maxie. Groudon leaves.
Fly to Slateport
Talk to Captain Stern outside the Harbor. Team Aqua takes the submarine.
Fly to Lilycove
Cross the northern ledges to the east side, then Surf into the cove.
Aqua Hideout
Warp panels over three floors. Beat Matt on B2F.

p: The first floor needs Strength. If nobody in your party knows it, the HM from Johto can be taught on the spot. The boulders reset when you leave and re-enter. Grunts are Level 93; deep inside, Maxie wakes Groudon with the Blue Orb, it leaves, and he battles you (Mightyena lead, Level 95).
In Slateport a crowd has gathered outside the Harbor for Captain Stern’s interview. Talk to him. Team Aqua announces over a megaphone that it is taking his submarine; inside, Archie leaves with it.

The hideout is the cave in Lilycove’s cove. The east half of the city is reached by hopping the ledges along the north side; from there Surf to the cave. Inside, warp panels connect three floors. Matt is on B2F and tells you Archie has already left for a cave under the sea. A panel near him leads out.

stuck: I can’t reach the Aqua Hideout
Go to the east side of Lilycove over the ledges on the north edge of the city, then Surf into the cove.
The Magma Hideout boulders moved back
They reset each time you enter. Push them again.
next: Surf east from Lilycove across Route 124.

chapters.title: Mossdeep City
chapters.sub: Tate & Liza and the Space Center
chapters.goal: Win the Mind Badge, defend the Space Center with Steven and receive Dive.
need: Surf.
quick: Surf across Route 124
Mossdeep is the island to the east.
Mossdeep Gym
Coloured switches move the statues and trainers one step round their loops. Double Battle with Tate & Liza.
Space Center
Magma grunts on 1F; three in a row on 2F; then a tag battle with Steven against Maxie and Tabitha.
Visit Steven’s house
He gives you HM09 Dive.

p: The floor has five colours of switch. Each press moves every statue and trainer of that colour one step around a small loop of arrows, opening and closing paths; warp panels link the sections. There are six Gym trainers at Level 95.
Tate & Liza fight as a Double Battle. Claydol leads at Level 96. Reward: Mind Badge and TM04 Calm Mind.

Team Magma has come for rocket fuel. On the ground floor a grunt guards the stairs and steps aside once beaten. In builds up to v102 he could reappear on the stairs if you walked to the far end of the floor; that was fixed in v103. If you carry a save made inside the building on an older build and he blocks you once, leave the building and come back in.
Upstairs three grunts fight one after another. Steven then asks you to battle alongside him: choose three Pokémon for a tag battle against Maxie and Tabitha.
Afterwards visit Steven’s house in the north-west of Mossdeep. He gives you HM09 Dive. In Project Blonde HM08 is Whirlpool, so Dive is HM09.

bosses.title: Gym Leaders Tate & Liza
know: A Double Battle. Dark, Ghost and Bug moves; spread moves such as Surf and Earthquake hit your own partner too.

bosses.title: Maxie & Tabitha
know: You bring three Pokémon; Steven brings Metang, Aggron and Skarmory.

items: From Steven in his house in Mossdeep after the Space Center.
From the sailor on the Space Center’s ground floor.
stuck: A Magma grunt is back on the Space Center stairs
A bug in builds up to v102, fixed in v103. On an older build, or once from an old save made inside the building, leave the Space Center and walk back in.
Which HM is Dive?
HM09, from Steven. HM08 is Whirlpool.
next: Surf south from Mossdeep along Route 127 to Route 128.
chapters.ev: v102 trace 194–197; issue M-3, fixed in v103

chapters.title: Seafloor Cavern
chapters.goal: Confront Archie under the sea, then end the weather crisis from the top of the Sky Pillar.
need: Dive, Surf, Rock Smash and Strength.
quick: Route 128: Dive in the southern deep patch
Follow the trench to the submarine and surface in the cavern.
Seafloor Cavern
Rooms 1 → 2 → 7 → 3 → 8 → 9. Beat Archie; Kyogre leaves.
Route 126: Dive on the south side of the crater
Surface inside Sootopolis City.
Follow Steven to the Cave of Origin
Tell Wallace the answer is the Sky Pillar.
Surf Routes 129–131 to the Sky Pillar
Enter the inlet on Route 131 from the south-east.
Climb to the top
Rayquaza flies off. Fly back to Sootopolis: the crisis is over.

p: Room 1: smash the rock at tile (5,10) from (4,10), push the boulder up from (5,12), then push the second boulder east from (11,11). Room 2 has two more rocks and boulders. Room 7 is fast water that carries you. In Room 3 an Admin and a grunt wait (Level 95–97). Room 8 is a twelve-boulder puzzle. Room 9 holds TM26 Earthquake and, further in, Archie.
Archie leads with Mightyena at Level 97 and his Sharpedo Mega Evolves. The Red Orb wakes Kyogre, which leaves. You come out onto Route 128 in a downpour.

steps.t: Sootopolis and the Cave of Origin
p: Sootopolis sits inside a crater on Route 126 and is entered underwater from the crater’s south side. Groudon and Kyogre are fighting in the city. Steven leads you to the Cave of Origin, where Wallace asks where Rayquaza might be. Answer: the Sky Pillar.

Surf south from Mossdeep along Routes 127 to 131. On this first climb the tower already has cracked floors. On 4F, step onto the cracked tile at (6,4), fall to 3F and take the middle stairs back up: that puts you on the west half of 4F and on toward the top. No bike is needed.
At the summit Rayquaza wakes and flies to Sootopolis. Fly there. Wallace thanks you with a Rare Candy (in place of Waterfall, which you already own) and opens the Gym.

bosses.title: Aqua Leader Archie
know: Mega Sharpedo is very fast after Mega Evolving and hits hard, but faints to almost any strong Fighting, Electric or Grass move.

items: From Wallace in Sootopolis after the crisis (in place of Waterfall).
stuck: Where do I Dive for the Seafloor Cavern?
Route 128, in the deep-water patch at the southern end. Follow the trench underwater to the submarine and surface.
How do I get into Sootopolis?
Dive on Route 126 at the south side of the crater and surface inside.
The Sky Pillar seems blocked on 4F
Step on the cracked tile at (6,4) on 4F, drop to 3F and climb the middle stairs.
Wallace asks where Rayquaza is
Choose SKY PILLAR.

chapters.title: Sootopolis City
chapters.goal: Cross three floors of thin ice and beat Juan.
need: The weather crisis resolved.
quick: Enter the Gym
Three ice floors in a row.
Step on every ice tile exactly once
The stairs open when the whole floor is cracked. Step on a tile twice and you fall.
Beat Juan
Reward: Rain Badge and TM03 Water Pulse.
Stock up at the Mart
Max Potion, Revive and Full Heal are sold here.

p: The three floors have 7, 19 and 38 ice tiles. Falling lands you in the basement among the Gym trainers, and you climb back to try again. After the Badge the way out is also through the basement, since the ice you used is broken.
Juan leads with Luvdisc at Level 97 and has Crawdaunt, Whiscash and a Kingdra with Double Team, Rest and Ice Beam. It was the longest Gym battle of the playthrough.
Full Restores are not sold anywhere before the League lobby, so buy Max Potions and Revives here.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Juan
know: Kingdra’s Double Team makes this a war of attrition. Moves that cannot miss, or Dragon and Fairy moves landed early, shorten it.
Electric handles the rest; Whiscash is immune to it, so keep a Grass move.

stuck: The stairs in the ice Gym won’t open
Every ice tile on the floor must be stepped on once. Plan a path that does not cross itself.
next: Fly to Mossdeep, Surf south to Route 128 and leave by its east edge.

chapters.title: Ever Grande City
chapters.goal: Climb the waterfall, cross Victory Road and meet Wally one more time.
need: Waterfall, Surf, Strength and Rock Smash.
quick: Leave Route 128 by its east edge
Ever Grande lies to the east, not the south.
Use Waterfall in the city
The Pokémon Center is at the top.
Victory Road
Wally battles you soon after the entrance. Heal with items between trainers.
Reach the League side
The door guards check all eight Hoenn Badges.

p: Wally is in the west corridor of 1F with five Pokémon at Level 97–99.

The route used in the playthrough, with tile coordinates: 1F ladder (9,14) → B1F, push the boulder at (4,7) west and the one at (9,10) east → ladder (30,25) → B2F, Surf and Waterfall → ladder (5,26) → B1F south-west: smash the rock at (20,25), push the boulder at (20,26) south, smash (21,26) → ladder (20,21) → 1F → exit at (39,5).
Two strong trainers stand back to back on the last stretch. The playthrough blacked out there once; use items between battles.

bosses.title: Pokémon Trainer Wally
know: His Gardevoir Mega Evolves. Steel and Poison moves are the answer.

stuck: I can’t find Ever Grande City
Leave Route 128 by its east edge, then use Waterfall inside the city.
next: The building at the top of Ever Grande.

chapters.title: The Hoenn League
chapters.goal: Beat Sidney, Phoebe, Glacia, Drake and the Champion.
need: All eight Hoenn Badges.
Full Restores and Revives: the lobby Mart is the first place in Hoenn that sells Full Restores (¥3,000).
quick: Shop in the lobby
Full Restore, Max Potion, Revive, Full Heal, Ultra Ball.
Four rooms in order
Sidney (Dark), Phoebe (Ghost), Glacia (Ice), Drake (Dragon). Each has a Mega Evolution. Level 96–99.
Champion Wallace
Wailord leads at Level 100.
Hall of Fame and credits
About five minutes. Continue resumes in Littleroot Town.

p: Each room locks behind you and items are your only healing between battles. Sidney’s Absol, Phoebe’s Banette, Glacia’s Glalie and Drake’s Salamence Mega Evolve.
The Champion is Wallace. In the playthrough a party with two Pokémon at Level 100 and four at 85–95 won on the first attempt, using about seven Revives and eighteen Max Potions along the way.
After the Hall of Fame the HGSS-style credits roll, followed by THE END and the title screen. Choose Continue and you are in Littleroot Town outside Professor Birch’s lab, Champion of three regions.

know: Electric and Grass cover most of the team; Whiscash and Ludicolo each resist one of them, so bring both.
His Gyarados Mega Evolves and becomes Water / Dark.
